ADAPTIVE.Definition: changing to suit each user's needs

ENGAGING.Definition: interesting enough to hold your attention

INTERACTIVE.Definition: two-way, with the learner and the tool responding to each other

APPROACH.Definition: begin to deal with or think about

ALGORITHMS.Definition: step-by-step rules that a computer follows to solve problems

RELIABLY.Definition: in a way that can be trusted to work well every time

INFLUENTIAL.Definition: having a lot of power to change what others think or do

INPUTS.Definition: information or instructions given to a computer

ENDLESS.Definition: without limit; too many to count

EXAGGERATION.Definition: a statement that makes something seem bigger or more important than it really is

THE ELEPHANT IN THE ROOM.Definition: the obvious problem that people avoid talking about

SOME WAY OFF.Definition: a long distance or time away

INTERNALISED.Definition: made fully part of your own knowledge

EXPLORATION.Definition: a careful study of a subject
